description_en: Queries the ROS Agent V2 session list of the current user by paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前用户的ROS Agent V2会话列表
name: ListChatSessions

parameters.help_en: The number of sessions to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的会话数量，范围 1 到 100，默认值为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned in the previous response. Do not pass this parameter for the first page. Do not reuse an old token after switching Mode
parameters.help_zh: 上一次响应返回的翻页 Token；第一页不传，切换 Mode 后不要复用旧 Token
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to V2 to route requests to the ROS Agent V2 backend
parameters.help_zh: 传 V2 路由到 ROS Agent V2 后端
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.help_en: Filters sessions by mode. Valid values: IaCCodeNormal and IaCCodePipeline
parameters.help_zh: 按会话模式筛选，仅支持 IaCCodeNormal 或 IaCCodePipeline
parameters.name: mode
